_note: Your own fine-tune of zimage / krea2 / qwen / klein. Put the diffusion model in a folder named after its engine: models/diffusion_models/zimage/my-zimage-finetune.safetensors, and use its file name (with or without .safetensors) as the model. The folder says the engine; the text encoder and VAE stay the official ones of that engine. To change those too, or to use a fine-tune that is online, write the model as an object - see configs/basics/08-from-url.json.
